products.description: Traditionally, this two piece tile, also referred to as 'Mission Barrel', was the most frequently used roof tile in Europe and particularly in Spanish colonial buildings in the new world. Today the Medio Curva tile is used in the construction of new homes, due to the beauty and wide variety of colours available, or on existing projects to restore historic roofs to their former beauty.
products.dimensions: length 500mm; width 210mm; height 63mm; 18 units/sqm; minimum pitch with sarking 27°
